project.name: context-sanitizer-slm-data-pipeline
project.objective: Build a privacy-preserving, human-in-the-loop data-labeling pipeline that ingests raw incident/log dumps, redacts secrets and PII, and emits a versioned, audit-stamped, character-offset-anchored labeled dataset for training and evaluating a 1.5B context-distillation SLM.

approval.reason: thin-slice v1 spec matches the design discussion and outline

assumptions.text: A 1.5B SLM can produce usable candidate label spans + evidence for pre-annotation; model quality for the propose-labels stage is not yet validated.
Single-reviewer v1 throughput is sufficient to produce enough labeled data before multi-reviewer/IAA is needed.
Raw dumps are primarily incident/log text (PagerDuty-style); other source types/formats are not yet characterized.

Tech-stack choices in 03-design supersede task.md's 'stack not yet decided' per the design doc's stated document precedence; treated as authoritative pending human confirmation. (Recorded as unresolved disagreement between artifacts.)

Research 'Unverified' sub-facts must be confirmed before relying on them: exact Argilla/Doccano span JSON shapes, Prefect pause-timeout terminal state, Airflow HITL exact version, Pydantic Field constraint specifics, Llama-3 tokenizer spurious offsets.

invariants.text: Every label span is stored as code-point character offsets {start,end} into the raw text; raw secret/PII text never appears in annotations, exports, or the review DOM (offset-only, W3C TextPositionSelector).
Secret and PII scanning run fully offline in the sensitive path: no live verification or network calls (detect-secrets -n / no --verification).
Per-record audit metadata (reviewer, timestamp, model version, policy version) is stored as columns on each record; the audit log is append-only, stores HMAC hashes not plaintext, and fails closed.
Thread/document grouping has no cross-split leakage: an entire source thread is assigned wholly to a single dataset split.
Authorization is enforced server-side; unredacted spans are returned only on an explicit, logged, policy-permitted request.

decisions.title: v1 scope = thin end-to-end slice
decisions.text: First implementation builds every DAG stage in its simplest honest form, single-reviewer, no orchestrator. Defer adjudication queue (flat needs-second-look flag), IAA, multi-reviewer, multi-tenant RBAC.

decisions.title: No orchestrator in v1; DB-state HITL, Prefect later
decisions.text: Human-review pause is DB state (pending_review table flipped by the review API); a plain worker loop advances records. Keep review state in our own DB so orchestrator choice stays reversible; adopt Prefect when multi-batch retries/observability are needed. Temporal only if waits reach weeks.

decisions.title: Thin custom React review tool, not off-the-shelf
decisions.text: Build a one-screen annotation/review tool (accept/rewrite/skip/reject/escalate) storing only {doc_id,start,end,label}. Rejected Label Studio CE (review/IAA Enterprise-only), Prodigy (commercial), Argilla (maintenance-only)/Doccano (no adjudication).

decisions.title: spaCy owns offsets; no destructive normalize in v1
decisions.text: Keep raw text verbatim (doc.text==input_text); use Doc.char_span(strict) whose None return is the invalid-span signal. No normalized->raw index map. If normalization is later needed, prefer HF library-tracked normalizers over a hand-rolled map.

decisions.title: PII/secret scan = Presidio + offline secret scanner
decisions.text: Presidio for entity PII + custom PatternRecognizers for Bearer/sk- tokens; detect-secrets --no-verify (or gitleaks stdin) for key long-tail; merge spans, secret-scanner wins on overlap. Redaction via Presidio Anonymizer, all in-environment.

decisions.title: Pydantic per-record validation; Pandera dataset-gate later
decisions.text: One Pydantic model is both the SLM output contract and the validation gate; cross-field span rules and conditional-required evidence live in @model_validator(mode=after). Add Pandera at dataset level once batches are large.

decisions.title: DVC + thread-grouped JSONL; HF datasets for trainer
decisions.text: Version data/<thread_id>.jsonl with DVC + private remote; per-record audit as JSONL columns. Emit HF datasets splits for the SLM trainer; thread-grouping enforced by our own split logic. Move to lakeFS if hook-enforced audit fields are wanted.

decisions.title: Minimal-but-correct-shaped access/audit in v1
decisions.text: Single reviewer role; API returns redacted text by default, serves unredacted span only on explicit logged view_unredacted; append-only HMAC audit that fails closed. Add RBAC/ABAC + policy engine when a second reviewer or sensitivity tier exists.

decisions.title: Python backend + thin React/TS review UI
decisions.text: Backend in Python (Presidio, spaCy, Pydantic, DVC, HF datasets native). One small React/TS screen for review; server-rendered + vanilla JS acceptable to start. Rejected Streamlit (awkward span interaction, harder to make privacy-safe).

decisions.title: 03-design stack supersedes task.md
decisions.text: Approving SPEC.md confirms the 03-design-discussion tech stack (Python: Presidio, spaCy, Pydantic, DVC, HF datasets; thin review screen) supersedes task.md's 'stack not yet decided'. Resolves ASSUMPTION-fd80e5a6 stack question.

knowledge.title: Offsets are the universal span contract
knowledge.text: Every surveyed tool (Presidio, spaCy, HF fast tokenizers, W3C selector, Label Studio/Argilla/Doccano/Prodigy) represents spans as {start,end} char offsets, so offset preservation is the integration seam tying intake->annotation->validation together.

knowledge.title: Presidio lacks built-in secret entities
knowledge.text: Presidio has no built-in API_KEY/BEARER_TOKEN entity; keys/tokens come from secret scanners (gitleaks/trufflehog/detect-secrets, all accept stdin) or custom PatternRecognizers. Scanner verification makes live network calls - disable for sensitive data.

knowledge.title: spaCy gives a free invalid-span signal
knowledge.text: spaCy guarantees doc.text==input_text; Doc.char_span(start,end,alignment_mode=strict) returns None when offsets do not land on token boundaries, which is a natural invalid-span signal. Length checks are NOT proof offsets survived normalization.

knowledge.title: HITL pause separates the orchestrators
knowledge.text: Native human-wait pause/resume: Temporal (durable signals, years), Airflow 3.1+ (HITL operators), Prefect (pause/suspend with Pydantic form). Dagster has no pause primitive (issue 14681) and needs a split-run+sensor workaround.

knowledge.title: Per-record audit belongs in columns
knowledge.text: Across DVC/lakeFS/HF datasets/Delta/Git-LFS, per-record audit (reviewer/timestamp/model/policy) lives as record columns; commit/tag metadata only carries batch-level facts. Grouping by thread is always a self-defined partition, never an automatic no-leakage guarantee.
